an4.24:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sākete viharati kāḷakārāme.
an4.24:2.1: yaṃ bhikkhave sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tamahaṃ jānāmi
an4.24:3.1: yaṃ bhikkhave sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tamahaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ
an4.24:3.2: taṃ tathāgatassa viditaṃ taṃ tathāgate na upaṭṭhāsi
an4.24:4.1: yaṃ bhikkhave sadevakassa lokassa … diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tamahaṃ jānāmīti vadeyyaṃ taṃ mamassa musā …
an4.24:5.1: tamahaṃ jānāmi ca na ca jānāmīti vadeyyaṃ taṃ pissa tādisameva …
an4.24:6.1: tamahaṃ neva jānāmi na na jānāmīti vadeyyaṃ taṃ mamassa kali
an4.24:7.1: iti kho bhikkhave tathāgato diṭṭhā daṭṭhabbaṃ diṭṭhaṃ na maññati adiṭṭhaṃ na maññati daṭṭhabbaṃ na maññati diṭṭhānaṃ na maññati
an4.24:7.2: sutā sotabbaṃ sutaṃ na maññati assutaṃ na maññati sotabbaṃ na maññati sutānaṃ na maññati
an4.24:7.3: mutā motabbaṃ mutaṃ na maññati amutaṃ na maññati motabbaṃ na maññati mutānaṃ na maññati
an4.24:7.4: viññātā viññātabbaṃ viññātaṃ na maññati aviññātaṃ na maññati viññātabbaṃ na maññati viññātānaṃ na maññati
an4.24:7.5: iti kho bhikkhave tathāgato diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu tādisova tādī
an4.24:7.6: tamhā ca pana tādimhā añño tādī uttaritaro vā paṇītataro vā natthīti vadāmīti.
